svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Semantic zoom: one continuous camera flight from L0 to L5
svg.desc: Design-spec storyboard of one continuous camera flight through the infrastructure ladder during INC-2041, in six rendered 3D frames: (1) L0 estate world with eu-west-1 glowing, (2) L1 region eu-west-1 plateau with zones and the prod-eu-1 city band, (3) L2 cluster prod-eu-1 city, footprint = capacity and height = load, with the payments nodes glowing, (4) L3 node ip-10-4-7-21 as a building with walls cut away to show its pods, (5) L4 pod payments-7f9c with its container cells, (6) L5 container app with its CPU profile rising as a 3D flame stack. Each frame shows its ladder level, elapsed time and what was pre-fetched on approach. A camera path line joins the frames; a caption strip gives the interaction: double-click dives, Esc rises one level, Home returns to L0.

g.text: L0 Landscape ⟶ L5 Container · INC-2041 · 12:24 · infra ladder · Orbit mode
No cuts, no loading states: each container expands into its children at a 120 px footprint, with data fetched on approach.
↓ region summaries: worst state, counts, histograms (8)
↓ orchestrator events for zone 1b, last 30 min
prod-eu-1 city · footprint = capacity, height = load
↓ pods on 6 hot nodes, requests vs usage
walls cut away · footprint = request · height = usage
width = CPU share · up = call depth
app · process profile rises as a 3D flame stack
↓ leaf level: nothing further to fetch
↓ Esc ×5 or Home flies back to L0
dive one level: an eased 450–500 ms flight, framed on the children
rise exactly one level, back to the previous framing
frame the whole estate at L0 in one flight; Alt+← steps back
zoom on the cursor; expand at 120 px, collapse at 60 px
eu-west-1 is the only colour on the planet
walls drop as the camera enters the node
dashed = camera flight; chips = eased time
prod-eu-1 crosses it; nodes crossfade in 150 ms
